Home › PlayStation 5 DualSense Controller 'Press Play' — Amazon Reveals Full PlayStation x Lisa Merch Collection as the Blackpink Star Drops New EP
 Lalisa la diva.
 By  Blythe Dujardin Updated : Oct 23, 2026 4:00pm UTC 15 comments Add IGN on Google Following PlayStation's announcement of a Lisa Edition DualSense controller , Amazon has dropped a full collection based on the new partnership. The full merch drop arrives just as Lisa releases her new EP ‘Press Play.' 
 The Lisa x PlayStation collection includes new apparel, accessories, and a restock of the Lisa-themed DualSense controller. Amazon has a full page dedicated to the collaboration , with several additional apparel items available exclusively from PlayStation Direct . 
 Lisa x PlayStation Collection Now Available at Amazon
 LISA x PlayStation Shop the Full Collection
 11 See it at Amazon The Lisa Edition DualSense controller is now in stock at Amazon at the same price as PS Direct: $84.99. The controller joins an ever-growing list of limited edition PS5 controllers that very rarely get restocks after selling out. 
 The DualSense controller is still up for preorder with a release date of October 30. The other drop in the collection that’s not available yet is a matching “Lisa” variant of PowerA’s DualSense protection case, releasing November 10. 
 The rest of the collection is available now. The merchandise features different iterations on the controller’s design: an artistic rendering of Lisa’s eyes, her “LL” logo, and the classic PlayStation button quartet.

 3 $35.00 at Amazon LISA x PlayStation™ Official Merch Collectible Metal Bag Charm Keychain

 3 $10.00 at Amazon Apparel makes up the bulk of the collection. Graphic t-shirts start at $40, with longer sleeve shirts and hoodies reaching up to $65. A “Dad” and “Trucker” hat are both $40, and two very similar tote bag designs are $35. For under $20, you'll find three different keychain designs as well as a metallic sticker sheet. 
 Several pricier items have also popped up on PlayStation Direct , including a knit beanie design and even more hoodies. 
 Lisa rose to fame as the leading rapper and dancer of the record-breaking girl group Blackpink. She made her solo debut with the “Lalisa” single album in 2021. Her new EP was released alongside a new music video for the single 'Tarantino.' 
 The Thai artist shared what attracted to her to a PlayStation collaboration as she geared up for the new EP release: 
 “Gaming is something I do whenever I have time to relax, so getting to create this collection with PlayStation was very exciting. I had a lot of fun adding in little details that I knew my fans would notice, and I wanted the fans to have something they can connect with. I’ve always loved expressing myself through music and fashion, so this collaboration gave me a new way to be creative and show a different side of myself. I hope everyone enjoys it as much as I do.” – LISA
 Amazon is also hosting an exclusive CD variant of Lisa’s new EP, Press Play, which is now streaming across most music platforms.
